result:
I've finished the edit-comment change in `apps/react-vite`. I haven't run tests, lint or the app, as you asked, so none of it has been run or type-checked.

- **API:** `features/comments/api/update-comment.ts` adds `updateComment`, which sends `PATCH /comments/{commentId}` with the new body. It also adds a Zod schema and a `useUpdateComment` hook that refreshes the comments list after saving.
- **Success message:** The "Comment Updated" notification is shown inside the hook's `onSuccess`. I put it there because `docs/api-layer.md` says components never call `useNotifications` themselves. The existing create and delete comment components still do, so this one is different.
- **Edit button:** `features/comments/components/update-comment.tsx` is an "Edit Comment" button that opens a form drawer prefilled with the current body.
- **Own comments only:** I added a `comment:update` policy in `lib/authorization.tsx` that is true only when the comment's author is the current user. Admins don't get an Edit button on other people's comments, though they can still delete them.
- **Comments list:** `comments-list.tsx` shows the Edit button next to Delete, behind that policy.
- **Mock API:** I added a `PATCH` handler in `testing/mocks/handlers/comments.ts` that only updates a comment when the caller is its author.
